description.value: You can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum HP by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1 to 9 instead of 11.
You move quickly. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
You react more quickly than others. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady. Make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.
With a burst of speed, you charge at an enemy. Stride twice. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy.
You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly. When using a ranged volley weapon while in this stance, you don't take the penalty to attack rolls from the volley trait.
You deftly dodge out of the way. Trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
You gain +1d6 precision damage on Strikes against flat-footed creatures. This damage is sneak attack damage.
Your experience with magic tells you when magic is afoot. You can cast detect magic as an arcane innate spell at will, with a spell level equal to your highest arcane spell slot.

You can apply natural cures to heal your allies. You can use Nature instead of Medicine to Treat Wounds. If you're in the wilderness, you might have easier access to fresh ingredients, giving a +2 circumstance bonus to your check.
